title.narrative: TGO-Strengthening CEOMP trainers’ capacity of mine clearance

description.narrative: n a western sub-region plagued by various political and security tensions, the role of the Peacekeeping Operations Training Centre is increasingly important in building the capacity of troops to deploy on mission and to serve in the north of the country, which is plagued by violence from unidentified armed groups. In recent years, with the support of the Japanese government, the centre has been able to provide high-quality training to troops deployed by Togo, as well as to military trainees from other countries.This new project aims to provide the Togo Peacekeeping Operations Training Centre (CEOMP) with additional capacity to train troops for pre-deployment in peacekeeping missions and the Togo north region. More specifically, the project will increase the technical and capacity of the CEOMP and strengthen the technical capabilities of the military and police personnel of pre-deployed troops so that they can protect themselves and the population against attacks by imploded explosive devices.
